main_result: Adaptive scheduling preserves complete greedy certificates, has quadratic candidate tests per closure and gives a 14.413 paired ratio on the largest five-cycle interval fixture including proof replay. Peak heap storage is quadratic; easy duplicate rows build no heap.
normal_result: Complete 128-tetrahedron disk query paired ratio 1.361 with five ratios 1.265 to 1.441. All normal fixture merger-test counts are unchanged; indexed periodic scans skip repeated nonperiodic scans.
limitations: No reliable full-coordinate speedup: 128-tetrahedron median paired ratio 1.014 masks individual ratios 0.629 and 0.733. Small duplicate-row adaptive regression 0.969. No whole-knot timing or general QP complexity improvement claimed.
research_status: Scheduler integrated. Other weighted/profile overlay not applied over newer independent native checker. Persistent whole-block representation and geometric output bounds remain separate follow-up work.
